Evolution Annotation

Incoming-table-driven evolution annotation

For each case, inspect the existing relational database and the incoming table. Select every operation that you consider reasonable. More than one operation may be selected.

  • Insert: the incoming rows belong to an existing relation without requiring new attributes.
  • Extend: an existing relation should gain one or more attributes represented by the incoming table.
  • Create: the incoming table represents a distinct relation that should be added to the database.

Use only the information shown. There is no need to design column mappings or constraints.
